authorization: AD-001, R0-F row; active approval record 2026-08-20
classification: Bounded physical-MEGA65 measurement, capture, diagnosis, and phase-sweep evidence
proof_question: Whether a freshly rebuilt, fully gated R0-F carrier corresponding to the owner-accepted R0-E configuration can produce attributable physical timing, DMA/IRQ (only if separately admitted), input/audio, snapshot, high-water, shedding, reserve, and storage-inactivity observations on a pinned MEGA65 platform.

upstream_status.r0e_accepted_scope: bounded combined-load functional proxy and read-only raster observation
upstream_status.r0e_xemu_for_rev3: NOT RERUN; cannot be inherited by R0-F

authorized: R0-F-owned admission, ownership, execution-plan, test-guide, evidence-map, interface/ledger-impact, and stage-control records
fresh D81 construction from R0-F source payloads only after the records and host implementation are ready
host structural/content verification, then two clean Xemu boots of the exact R0-F D81
physical identity capture, MEGA65-native-slot transfer, chooser verification, and bounded physical observations
separately justified DMA or IRQ instrumentation only after its wrapper contract documents registers, ownership, save/restore, clobbers, failure behavior, and validation
prohibited: reuse, copy, append to, rename, or retest F65R0EG.D81 or any retired carrier
inherit or fabricate an Xemu, DMA, IRQ, latency, elapsed-time, limit, or platform-identity result
freeze measured limits, select production values, open Phase 1, or implement gameplay
modify preserved specifications, CoreRuntime, public ABI, memory ownership, 100 Hz tick order, pool capacity, or reserve
physical chooser testing before the exact R0-F D81 passes every preceding D81 state

carrier.state: UNVERIFIED — no R0-F filename, payload set, D81, or release record assigned
carrier.construction: Fresh format and all payload writes in one pinned toolchain/vice-clean/bin/c1541 session; source payloads only.
carrier.delivery: Fresh unique uppercase 8.3 MEGA65-created root slot followed only by sudo tools/diagnostics/d81_sd_fill_mega65_slot.sh SOURCE.D81 /Volumes/MEGA65FDISK EXPECTED_SHA256.

required: MEGA65 model, revision, serial or board identity where available
video standard, selected mode, and output configuration
storage device/media identity and FAT32 volume identity
input devices and measurement-capture tooling identity

measurement.threshold_policy: Only approved-source thresholds may be evaluated. All other R0-F outputs are observations for human measured-limits review.

platform_wrapper.dma: DMA_HARDWARE_PROBE_NOT_EXECUTED until separately admitted and executed
platform_wrapper.irq: IRQ_MEASUREMENT_NOT_EXECUTED until separately admitted and executed
platform_wrapper.registers_clobbers: NOT_APPLICABLE — no R0-F target wrapper exists
platform_wrapper.map_base_page: NOT_APPLICABLE — no R0-F target wrapper exists
platform_wrapper.nmi: NOT_APPLICABLE — no gameplay NMI source is enabled

exit: R0-F cannot be called passed until complete physical evidence is reviewed and explicitly accepted by the owner.
